title: Four threshold-transition types
research_question: Which paired predictions cross the detector threshold?
main_observation: No primary complete frames; estimates are unavailable. Four class-specific crossings are counted: detected→missed and missed→detected for phishing; legitimate→false-positive and false-positive→legitimate for legitimate messages. Unchanged predictions are excluded.
allowed_interpretation: N is the class denominator; eligible_N is the baseline state at risk of each crossing; absent-class rates remain unavailable.
forbidden_interpretation: Do not combine phishing misses and legitimate false positives as a single evasion measure.
